units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 37b">B. Bath. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>האי מאן</he> … <he>בשִׁיפּוּדֵיה עד וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>משיפוליה</he>) if one sells a palm tree to his neighbor, the latter has the ownership of the soil in which it is rooted, down to the deep; <cite ref="Arakhin 14b:31">Arakh. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>משיפולא ועד וכ׳</he>.—V. <cite ref="U01715"><he>שַׁפּוּדָא</he></cite>.
